description: Routing cases for evaluating whether an agent should invoke Agent Artifacts and which semantic kind it should select.

cases.prompt: Make a plan for moving authorization into session lookup.
Write up exactly how another engineer should execute this database migration, including rollback and verification.
Give me a progress report for the WellSky ingest migration.
Show what shipped, what drifted from our original approach, what is blocked, and the next three moves.
Write the ADR for choosing session-bound authorization.
Capture why we chose read replicas over application caching and what alternatives lost.
Explain the authorization architecture and data flow.
Create a mental model of this service for the next engineer, including boundaries, ownership, entry points, and failure modes.
Review this PR and put blocking findings first.
Audit this implementation against the plan and give me a verdict with evidence.
Research logical replication restart failures and synthesize the evidence and unknowns.
Investigate three OCR replacement approaches and tell me what the evidence actually establishes.
Write the incident report for QA jobs being assigned before redaction finished.
Build a postmortem with impact, timeline, mechanism, recovery, and prevention owners.
Create a handoff for the agent artifact work so another engineer can resume it.
Package the current mental model, decisions, changed files, remaining risks, and exact next commands for the next agent.
What does this function return?
Clean up these five meeting notes as Markdown.
Give me the shell command to run the tests.
Rewrite this short email more clearly.
Tell the team where this project stands.
Document our choice and the tradeoffs.
Make this system understandable to someone picking it up tomorrow.
Make this actionable for a different engineer.
